prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 54px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 58px · one-line width 679px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 934px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总团队成员第 34 周的工作状态、本周完成情况和下周计划，便于识别风险与跟进事项。","reading":"读者先按成员定位一行，再查看状态，并横向对照本周完成与下周计划；也可纵向扫描状态列，快速发现风险和阻塞。两列长文本会形成较高的行，同一行内较短单元格可利用已有高度。","groups":["成员和状态共同构成每行的快速识别区。","本周完成和下周计划都是按成员组织的叙述性工作信息，应便于横向比较；下周计划的最长单行内容更长。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名和状态标记及文字尽量保持在一行，便于快速识别。","数字、百分比、英文术语和其他不可断开的标识应保持完整。","四列表头尽量各占一行。"],"may_wrap":["本周完成和下周计划中的中文叙述可在自然断点换行。","较短叙述可利用同一行中较长叙述形成的高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [67, 75, 108, 109] · table 360×1650px · row heights [36, 315, 292, 315, 222, 246, 222] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [67, 75, 90, 127] · table 360×1580px · row heights [36, 246, 292, 269, 269, 222, 246] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 12 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [67, 75, 128, 89] · table 360×1975px · row heights [36, 385, 362, 385, 222, 315, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 16 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"成员、状态和四列表头均保持单行，识别区清晰；两列叙述宽度接近，便于横向对照，英文和数字未被拆开。","problems":"计划列多行仅容纳少量文字，前三位成员的计划明显长于完成情况，行内留下较大空白，也拉高了整表。","cause":"本周完成与下周计划分别为108px和109px，但计划内容总体更长；近乎均分宽度没有反映两列的内容差异。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"成员和状态仍易于纵向扫描，计划列更宽后，前三行的计划阅读节奏明显改善；表头保持单行，未出现单词中断。","problems":"本周完成列显得过窄，部分句子被切成很短的行；吴桐和何嘉俊的完成情况比相邻计划高出不少，形成不均匀的留白。","cause":"完成列仅90px，扣除内边距和边框后文字区为69px；把更多宽度给127px的计划列缓解了部分行，却使另一些行由完成列决定高度。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"本周完成列较宽，句子和数值的阅读节奏更舒展；成员、状态及表头仍清楚。","problems":"计划列成为细长文字带，前三行尤其高，与完成列之间出现大片空白，横向比较困难；整表也明显更长。","cause":"计划列只有89px，文字区为68px，而完成列占128px；较长的计划内容因宽度不足频繁换行，主导多数行高。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-plan","widths":[67,75,98,119],"change":"以r0B为基础，把8px从计划列移给完成列，缓解完成列的碎行，同时保留计划列的宽度优势。"},{"name":"plan-priority","widths":[67,75,94,123],"change":"在r0B与均衡方案之间取值，略加宽完成列，同时继续优先照顾前三行较长的计划。"},{"name":"compact-identifiers","widths":[65,75,100,119],"change":"成员列按46px单行内容加21px边距的估计需要67px，因此此方案以2px压缩测试实际姓名渲染是否仍能保持单行；释放的空间分给完成列，以改善两列叙述的阅读节奏。"}]}
